minorQualityObservations.detail: Personal-calculation refusals remain longer than the intended brief default: English 133 words / 41.5 seconds; Spanish 100 words / 35.9 seconds. Neither provides an individual amount.
Initial explanations still include tuition residency classification wording before defining it; concept-first purpose is present, but that phrase could be simpler.
Some stage examples, repeated draft recaps and pre-tool narration remain. Spanish repeats Perfecto; neither language drifts into counseling.
Some finance/scope introductions omit I am or soy and say Hola, Origen, your AI guide. Identity is still clear.

limitations: Synthetic spoken inputs; no real human microphone, React UI, browser speaker playback, Auth0, database, production tool or full network recovery validation.
voiceSession is imported directly; server-loaded personalization and teaching-library context is not added.
All tool replies are explicitly marked syntheticEvaluationAdapter and persisted:false. A synthetic saved result validates response behavior only.
Connection failure is a deterministic client socket close, not an actual network outage.
The dated cumulative ledger retains unknown charges and transcription reservations. Cost uses undiscounted current prices; it is not an invoice.
Only six bounded synthetic conversations were evaluated; this is not a statistical reliability estimate.
Save, scope and research responses are deterministic nonpersistent adapters, not production writes, live official research, or production authorization checks.
Interruption truncation uses a simulated playback clock; speaker playback, perceived voice quality, pronunciation and accent were not subjectively assessed.
No browser UI recovery, Auth0, real microphone, server-loaded teaching-library context, or personalization retrieval is established by this run.
Source configuration hashes match the captured settings; the post-run fixture portability change removes only old audio-path dependencies.
